name: SIMPLE
full_name: Superheated Instrument for Massive ParticLe Experiments
summary: SIMPLE used superheated droplets at LSBB in France to study WIMPs and later explored a bubble-chamber upgrade. Portuguese teams contributed detector and calibration R&D.
detection_principle: Nuclear recoils nucleate bubbles in C2ClF5 superheated droplets suspended in gel. Acoustic signals and temperature-dependent thresholds discriminate backgrounds.

sites.name: LSBB
sites.site_status: Experiment site; see the phase descriptions

status.label: Multiple phases with different statuses
status.evidence: Phase II has a final analysis. A 2014 institutional paper still describes phases III/IV as prototypes and future plans.

collaboration.name: SIMPLE Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Only verified representative institutions are listed, not a complete membership roster. See the collaboration pages and author affiliations in the references.

key_parameters.name: Successor prototype
key_parameters.value: Approximately 1 kg bubble chamber, under test in 2014

phases.name: Phase III / IV
phases.description: 2014 prototype and expansion concept; latest implementation status unverified.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
